moment: The acolyte looks at the seam. Looks at you. Looks at the sky above the square, where something vast is already casting a shadow that the three suns cannot account for. "Then," the acolyte says, "I hope you are a slow looker." The walk to the shop is shorter than it should be. [What the fourth bell reveals →](022-the-lattice.md)
style: Engraved etching illustration, dense crosshatching, fine ink linework, monochrome, no colour. Heavy blacks, high contrast, deep shadow, dark inked plate. The characters are anthropomorphic cats.
